subject: PortLess Trade — Turmeric Finger Round 2
body:
Dear Krishna Spices,

Thank you for your revised quote. Our buyer confirms interest at USD 1,635/MT. After logistics the effective FOB ceiling is USD 1,610/MT. Could you revise toward USD 1,630/MT to unlock a 20 MT commitment this quarter?

Best regards,
PortLess Trade Desk
